g.text: Sequence Diagram - WEB05 Sellable Catalogue Consultation
WEB05 requires public read-only access to the sellable catalogue for Guests and signed-in users.
The request is public, requires no authentication token, and uses skipAuthFailureHandler: true.
request("GET", "/catalogue", { query: filters, signal, skipAuthFailureHandler: true })
request("GET", "/catalogue", { query: filters, signal, skipAuthFailureHandler: true })
displays catalogue and allergen information (BCK05 / ALN-1)
